# Security

Ponlai is a web app that runs in the browser, with development tools that run on your own machine.
It has no server of its own and handles no accounts or personal data.

## Supported versions

Only the latest commit on `main` gets fixes.

## Report a vulnerability

Report it privately through GitHub: on the repository's **Security** tab, select **Report a
vulnerability**. Do not open a public issue.

Say what the vulnerability is, how to reproduce it and what it affects. You will get an answer as
soon as the maintainer can; once a fix is released, the advisory is published with credit to you,
unless you ask otherwise.
